tests.name: AvailableTimes with a partial-day out-of-office window renders the slots before the window, one away panel, then the slots after it
AvailableTimes with a partial-day out-of-office window puts the panel first for a window at the start of the day
AvailableTimes with a partial-day out-of-office window puts the panel last for a window at the end of the day
AvailableTimes with a partial-day out-of-office window renders one panel per window when a day has two
AvailableTimes with a partial-day out-of-office window shows all booked and the waitlist options for a fully booked day instead of a blank panel
AvailableTimes with a partial-day out-of-office window renders only the panel when every slot is away, as a whole-day entry does
AvailableTimes with a partial-day out-of-office window renders a whole-day entry as the panel alone, without the slot list around it
AvailableTimes with a partial-day out-of-office window renders two panels when two overlapping entries end at the same time
AvailableTimes with a partial-day out-of-office window renders every slot and no panel on a day without an away entry
AvailableTimes with a partial-day out-of-office window drops the bottom padding of the last panel of the day, and only there
AvailableTimes with a partial-day out-of-office window offers the redirect user's booking page on the same date
AvailableTimes with a partial-day out-of-office window offers the redirect on the day the run starts when the run crosses midnight UTC
